description: This PHP class defines the EmployeeGender filter field used in the reporting framework of the OrangeHRM system. It extends FilterField and implements ValueXNormalizable, providing functionality to add gender-based filtering to queries, retrieve entity aliases, and convert gender values to an array representation.

classes.name: EmployeeGender
classes.description: Represents the gender filter field for employee reports, allowing filtering by gender and converting gender values to labels.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a gender filter condition to the query builder if the operator is equality and a gender value is set.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity aliases used in the query, here 'employee'.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the gender filter value into an array with 'id' and label ('Male' or 'Female').
